dock-render-tree.md cited: both entries under ONE shared DrawerErrorBoundary for input.dock, DockEntry adds no boundary, child throw unmounts the whole subtree (console 'unmounted entries: dsh-paste-input-dock, progress'); attach button survives because input.left is a different slot under a different boundary.

Toggle proves A caused the unmount and B renders once freed; explicitly does NOT prove B fully alpha.2-compatible elsewhere nor that A is the only dock defect; reinstalling B useless because B was never broken; colleague theory refuted since B uses no standard-kit hooks.

Corrected code reads pending via useSessionStatus statuses -> pendingInteraction with legacy fallback and a silent no-pending branch (stable hook order); only the attention indicator degrades while running/todos/token/ETA keep working; silent-degradation rationale tied to shared-boundary blast radius.

Verification without host restart (refresh/session-switch remount, both entries together, pending-path behavioral check); B regression covers paste/add/remove with A enabled plus fault-injection and kit matrix; hygiene: local per-entry boundaries, defensive destructuring, host per-entry boundary option with nesting/coherence trade-off discussed.
